newsitem.title: FRANCE: TABLE-Pechiney H1 sales rise 9.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Pechiney H1 sales rise 9.4 pct.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Pechiney said in a statement the preliminary figures showed an increase of 9.4 percent. Sales for 1996 include the revenue of divested businesses which totalled 636 million francs and sales for 1997 include the Food Can and Specialities division which was divested at the end of May 1997. Revenues of these activities amounted to 1.047 billion francs compared with 1.332 billion francs for the first six months of 1996. Figures restated to exclude all these elements showed a sales rise of 13 percent.

During the first half of 1997 the increase in consolidated sales also reflected an appreciation of the U.S. dollar against the French franc, which had a positive impact of approximatively 2.1 billion francs, almost half of which related to the International trade division. This division also recorded a strong increase in sales volume of its international trading activities.
All industrial sectors recorded higher sales volume, particularly alumium conversion activities and Cebal.
Pechiney International's preliminary consolidated sales for the first half of 1997 were 12.299 billion francs compared with 12.285 billion for the same period 1996.
Sales for 1996 include those of Intsel Southwest divested in 1996, which amounted to 351 million francs. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5432
